description: Box and Shape: a row of tone swatches (shares of the row, a fill and a border in a tone), a timeline with a canvas of bars per row, and a gauge, a triangle and a polyline in a row.

events.text:
```openui
root = Stack([intro, swatches, timeline, shapes])
intro = Text("A **swatch row**, a timeline and some shapes, built from `Box` and `Shape`")
swatches = Box([sa, sm, ss, sd], "row", "s", "none", null, null, null, "fill")
sa = Box([Text("accent")], "column", null, "s", null, null, null, 0.25, "accent", "accent", true)
sm = Box([Text("muted")], "column", null, "s", null, null, null, 0.25, "muted", "muted")
ss = Box([Text("success")], "column", null, "s", null, null, null, 0.25, "success")
sd = Box([Text("danger")], "column", null, "s", null, null, null, 0.25, null, "danger")
timeline = Box([design, build, ship], "column", "none", "s", null, null, null, "fill", null, "muted", true)
design = Box([Box([Text("Design")], "column", null, null, null, null, null, 0.2), Box([Shape("rect", [0, 0, 0.35, 1], "accent", true, 16)], "column", null, null, null, null, null, 0.8)], "row")
build = Box([Box([Text("Build")], "column", null, null, null, null, null, 0.2), Box([Shape("rect", [0.3, 0, 0.5, 1], "success", true, 16)], "column", null, null, null, null, null, 0.8)], "row")
ship = Box([Box([Text("Ship")], "column", null, null, null, null, null, 0.2), Box([Shape("rect", [0.75, 0, 0.2, 1], "danger", false, 16), Shape("line", [0.75, 0.5, 0.95, 0.5], "danger", false, 16)], "column", null, null, null, null, null, 0.8)], "row")
shapes = Box([gauge, tri, wave], "row", "m")
gauge = Box([Shape("arc", [0.5, 0.5, 0.45, 0, 1], "muted", false, 1), Shape("arc", [0.5, 0.5, 0.45, 0, 0.72], "accent", true, 1)], "column", null, null, null, null, null, 0.25)
tri = Box([Shape("path", [0.5, 0.05, 0.95, 0.95, 0.05, 0.95], "danger", true, 1)], "column", null, null, null, null, null, 0.25)
wave = Box([Shape("line", [0, 0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.6, 0.6, 0.1, 0.8, 0.5, 1, 0.2], "success", false, 1)], "column", null, null, null, null, null, 0.4)
```
